acceptanceCriteria: Every entry of protocol/cem-1.0/stable/manifest.json matches the sha256 and byte length of its file.
tools/cem-stable-regen --check verifies every stable manifest entry, not only RESULT.schema.json, and passes.
The repair is recorded in docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md with the predecessor digests.
body: Observed 2026-10-12 while building V1-1273 (tools/cem-stable-regen --check) on origin/main 2c81d1f3c and 1058de51f. protocol/cem-1.0/stable/manifest.json (cem-stable-protocol-manifest/1, 16 files) records REPOSITORY-ENVELOPE.cells.json as sha256 c3eed8b83713... / 302453 bytes and REPOSITORY-ENVELOPE.md as 9c35b7a5e681... / 9705 bytes, but the committed files are 6b3828ac703b... / 302947 bytes and dd33dcaf9362... / 10003 bytes. Both files and the manifest were last changed in the same commit fc5588948 (Integrate CEM stable repository and process envelope), so the manifest was sealed before the final bytes of those two files. The other 14 entries match. Reproduction: for each entry in manifest.json files[], compare sha256 and byte length of the named file. Expected: every entry matches. Actual: two mismatches. No consumer test currently verifies the stable manifest entries, so the defect was invisible. cem-stable-regen --check deliberately verifies only the RESULT.schema.json entry of this manifest (see tools/cem-stable-regen/main.go check()) and its first regeneration re-binds only that entry; once this manifest is repaired, widen the check to every entry. Fix: re-bind both entries (and any repair note the stable packet requires), document the repair in docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md traceability, then remove the only-schema restriction in cem-stable-regen check() and rebind.
title: cem/1.0 stable manifest.json: entries for REPOSITORY-ENVELOPE.cells.json and REPOSITORY-ENVELOPE.md are stale since fc5588948
